title: Teach the mailbox protocol and CLI fallback once to non-Codex root agents through their managed instructions
outcome: Raised by the Claude reviewer on the compact-wake slice (2026-09-06): the metadata-only mailbox wake names only termal_read_mailbox, and the read -> process -> acknowledge protocol plus the TERMAL_CLI / TERMAL_SESSION_ID / TERMAL_BASE_URL fallback are now taught once - in the MCP tool descriptions, the coordination CLI help, docs/features/agent-mailboxes.md and the TermAl-managed Codex AGENTS.md section. That managed section exists only for Codex homes. A Claude, Gemini or Cursor root session whose MCP tools are unavailable therefore has no in-band pointer to the CLI route. Desired: an equivalent managed-instructions surface for the other hosted agents (whatever each runtime reads once per session: Claude's injected instructions, ACP agents' instruction channel), carrying the same short protocol and the CLI fallback with env-supplied identity, kept in one shared text so the four copies cannot drift; the wake itself stays metadata-only. Acceptance: each supported root agent receives the teaching exactly once per session; a test pins the shared text and its presence per agent; the wake body unchanged.
disposal_reason: Backlog triage w-930e4d333f07 (Architect1 batch 2, spot-checked by Termal::Fable2): CLOSE-DONE. Landed in a0e3d29 (ancestor of master f7db2c58).
